title: ci(ui-merge): nothing deploys www.objectui.org since the nested workflows were deleted; deploy ui/apps/site from the root docs-deploy workflow (#25753 item 2)
body:
Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed). In the cleanup project thread on 2026-10-28, Tesla was shown the decision card "objectui 文档站 www.objectui.org 以后怎么处理？" and answered 「A」 (option A, 「立卡：从 ui/apps/site 部署」), then 「你负责处理」 and 「使用 pm-dispatch 技能」. This card carries #25753's item 2, "the docs site serves from the merged repo", which is the last open done-when item on #25753. Part of #25753.

## 维护者速读

objectui 的文档站 www.objectui.org 原来由 objectui 仓自己的 `docs-deploy.yml` 每 6 小时构建并推到 Vercel 项目 `prj_v1rXIczaI7YGmXmseQCLFUFOFxTB`。这个 workflow 已随 #26058 删除。根仓的 `docs-deploy.yml` 只部署 `apps/docs`,`ui/apps/site/vercel.json` 又关了 Git 自动部署,所以从 2026-10-26 起没有任何流程部署这个站,18.2 之后的文档改动都不会上线。本卡在根仓 `docs-deploy.yml` 里加第二个作业,按同一套 `vercel pull / build / deploy --prebuilt` 方式部署 `ui/apps/site`。它改的是 `.github/workflows/**`,属 Tier H,需要你批准合并。另外有一个只能你做的动作:Vercel 项目的 Root Directory 要从 `apps/site` 改成 `ui/apps/site`(见下文 Maintainer-action)。

## What is wrong

- objectui's `ui/.github/workflows/docs-deploy.yml` deployed the site on a cron (`43 5,11,17,23 * * *`) with `VERCEL_ORG_ID: team_06nvlGKZCkwhzdXmRdxeCNnB` and `VERCEL_PROJECT_ID: prj_v1rXIczaI7YGmXmseQCLFUFOFxTB`. That workflow was deleted by #26058 (its roster row 10: "→ sub-issue 4 · (none; objectui's site is a separate Vercel project)"). You can read it at #26058's parent, `be7897799b`.
- The root `.github/workflows/docs-deploy.yml` deploys one project only: `apps/docs`, `prj_KbPkuEVCj8viErlaC0wBUgMIYZWe`.
- `ui/apps/site/vercel.json` sets `git.deploymentEnabled: false`, so Vercel builds nothing on a push either.

**Who pays.** People who read the @object-ui docs at www.objectui.org: integrators of the published `@object-ui/*` packages, which shipped at 18.2.0. The site stays frozen at its last deploy from the archived repo, so it never shows any release after the merge. objectui's own record shows the same failure before: a skipped deploy froze the site for five weeks (objectui#12178, quoted in the old workflow's header). Not measured from a seat: the proxy refuses the site's host, so the live page's age was not read.

## Wanted

1. A second job in the root `docs-deploy.yml`, `Deploy objectui docs to Vercel (production)`, that keeps the root job's shape:
   - the same refusal step when `VERCEL_TOKEN` is absent or the ref is not `main`;
   - `vercel pull` → `vercel build --prod` → `vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod`, run from the repository root;
   - the same pinned `VERCEL_CLI_VERSION`;
   - the token passed only to the steps that call the Vercel API;
   - the root job's post-build output checks, here against `ui/apps/site/.next`.
   Its env takes the old objectui project id above, and the same team id the root job already uses.
2. The old workflow's `objectstack-pin.mjs build` steps are not ported: the merged tree builds `@objectstack/*` from the workspace. Check `ui/apps/site/vercel.json`'s `installCommand` / `buildCommand` (`cd ../.. && pnpm turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/site`) against the merged layout, and fix that file if needed. No PR job builds `@object-ui/site` today. objectui's `ci.yml` "Build Docs" job is row 7 of #26717, which left it to be decided with this deploy. Add that build to a ui lane under the `ui` filter so a PR predicts the deploy, or write on the card why not.
3. The root workflow's header text and any roster or self-test that pins the docs-deploy job list (`check-aggregator-roster`, `check-expected-skips`, `check-step-collectors`, workflow self-tests under `scripts/__tests__/`) are updated to match; each `--self-test` exits 0.

Maintainer-action: in the Vercel dashboard for project `prj_v1rXIczaI7YGmXmseQCLFUFOFxTB`, set Root Directory to `ui/apps/site` (it reads `apps/site` today, per the old workflow's header). Also confirm that the repository's `VERCEL_TOKEN` can deploy to that project — the root job's token belongs to the same team. This is done when the first `workflow_dispatch` run of the new job deploys and prints the deployment URL.

## Who acts

A `domain:devx` card thread (Tier H, `.github/workflows/**`): the PR stays draft until it is green, then GOVERNED_APPROVERS review it, the maintainer merges, and the seat never enqueues it. Proof is one `workflow_dispatch` run on `main` after the merge. If the maintainer action is not done yet, that run is expected to fail at `vercel build` on the old Root Directory. Record that on the card, and do not treat it as a code defect.

## Acceptance

- One green `workflow_dispatch` run of the new job on `main`, with the deployment URL on the card.
- A page changed after 2026-10-26 (any `ui/content/docs/**` edit on `main`) renders on www.objectui.org, read by the maintainer or by a seat whose network allows the host.
- The root `apps/docs` job is unchanged, and its next scheduled run stays green.

**Duplicate search.** objectstack-ai/objectstack, "objectui docs site deploy vercel ui/apps/site objectui.org": #25753 (open, item 2 is this card's source), #26058 (merged, deleted the workflow), #26944 (open, F14 CI docs page, different file). No card deploys the site. **New.**

**Size:** S–M. **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.
